bio: Welcome to Pierre Gagnaire's Italian restaurant, where the great chef proposes his personal and creative take on cucina italiana, beautifully made with rigorously selected produce. The dishes are punctuated with subtle contrasts created, for example, by bitter salad leaves, spices and condiments. You can look forward to a chic and opulent but nonetheless relaxed atmosphere, a warm welcome and expert recommendations on the best Italian wines from the sommelier. Booking strongly advised....
